title: Emberglow Outdoor Resort

services.name: Pedal kart rentals
services.desc: You don’t need to pack the bikes for your outdoor adventures. At Emberglow Outdoor Resort you can easily rent one from our fleet of quality adult and children’s bicycles as well as kids’ pedal karts. The Giant Talon 1 adult mountain bikes are great for getting around the resort or for riding the 3 miles of single track trails on the Emberglow property. These lightweight aluminum hard tail mountain bikes are equipped with 1X10 shifters, 29” tires, and disc brakes. They are available in 2 sizes, Large and Medium. services.name: RV Sites
services.desc: Your seasonal site from May through October means no reservations, no hauling, and more weekends spent relaxing at the pool, grilling, and making memories with friends and family. With the extra time a seasonal stay provides, you can experience things you would not normally fit into just a weekend visit. Take the time to explore nearby mountain towns, enjoy lake days, hike to waterfalls, visit wineries, and attend small-town festivals. No glamping destination would be complete without premium amenities. There’s plenty to make everyone in your group happy-from kids to the kids-at-heart.
